CERTIFICATION.purpose: Only candidates promoted from FAST research: parity, robustness, holdout, MT5 and final certification evidence.

storage_rules: Heavy research artifacts and caches go to Drive, not ChatGPT Library.
GitHub stores code, lightweight manifests, hashes, pointers and final receipts only.
Library is not used as the primary durable store for new QROS FAST runs.
Do not duplicate large artifacts across Drive and Library unless explicitly required for recovery.
Research FAST and Certification remain physically and logically separated.
